text:
sam_k: FYI — we're seeing pages without context. incidentbot is sending alerts into #incidents but the payloads are missing escalation/service metadata. Customers getting noisy emails ~08:42 UTC.

maria_g: got two duplicates, both show "undefined incident" in the subject. No service tag so automations didn't run.

alex_w: looking at notify-proxy logs now. I can see inbound webhook bodies that appear truncated — missing `escalation_id` and `service`. Not yet sure if provider truncated or our parser dropped it.

devops_bot: deploy/notify-proxy-v3.2.1 finished at 08:41:53 UTC on prod (rolling). No schema changes in that deploy.

alex_w: here's the raw snippet I'm seeing in the proxy: ```
POST /webhook/notify 200 OK
{"alert":"high qps","escalation_id":null,"service":null,"body":"...\n"signature":"sha256=..."}
```

oncall_liz: I'm oncall — paging me manually now. Stopping automated pages for hits without escalation_id would reduce noise. Can someone confirm we can mute incidentbot while we triage?

maria_g: I can push a suppressor rule in prod: `if payload.escalation_id == null -> drop` — hold for 30s while we validate.

infra_paul: Confirming notify-proxy is returning 200s to provider. I'm pulling the outgoing queue to see if retries caused duplicates.

alex_w: digging deeper — provider retries look normal. But our body parser uses content-length and we've seen a disconnect between `content-length` and actual body (client chunk cut). Parser treats missing fields as null and downstream routing defaults to fallback channel (#incidents).

maria_g: applied temporary suppressor at 08:46 UTC. New incoming pages with null escalation_id are being dropped. That stopped duplicate fanout. :thumbsup:

oncall_liz: I have paged PagerDuty directly for the live incident and notified the customer success lead. Taking ownership.

alex_w: root cause hypothesis: a transient LB connection reset truncated webhook payloads; our parser didn't validate schema and incidentbot routed with empty metadata. We'll harden parsing and add schema validation + length/checksum check.

devops_bot: rolling a hotfix branch to add request body size validation and reject truncated payloads (hotfix/notify-validate-1815).

infra_paul: also enabling stricter ingress timeouts on the LB and turning on request body logging (redacted) for a short window to correlate provider timings.

maria_g: after suppressor and manual oncall page, noise is down. Customer impact: a subset of alert emails went to customers without proper context for ~3 minutes (08:41:30-08:44:30). No data loss, only mis-routed notifications.

oncall_liz: confirmed minimal user impact; CS alerted a handful of customers; we've logged the affected customer IDs and will follow up.

alex_w: next steps: 1) merge hotfix and revert suppressor after deploy, 2) add integration test to simulate truncated body, 3) post-incident backfill for missed/partial alerts, 4) timeline + postmortem.

maria_g: I filed an incident ticket and added the temporary mitigation notes. Will create the postmortem draft after hotfix merge.

oncall_liz: tagging for follow-up: @maria_g (postmortem), @alex_w (fix), @infra_paul (LB), @sam_k (customer comms).

sam_k: Thanks everyone — appreciative of quick suppressor + manual handoff. Keeping this thread for timeline and final RCA.
